title: One agents-cli launch planner
current: exec.ts owns AGENT_COMMANDS and buildExecCommand, while runner.ts still owns six mode branches and a second routine command table.
incident: runner.ts emitted --model for Droid while exec.ts declares -m; PR 2764 corrects the symptom.
target: runner.ts passes routine lifecycle inputs into the canonical exec launch planner and keeps only scheduling, sandbox-home, spawn, timeout, and transcript lifecycle.
boundary: Exclude command jobs, workflow frontmatter launches, resume routing, and Codex Cloud transport.

title: One website source for both CLI domains
current: Both repositories claim to be the official site for the same npm package; agents-cli.sh currently redirects to agi-cli.sh.
target: Keep agi-cli-web as the source, merge any still-required seven unique alias-repo paths, and replace agents-cli-web with redirect/deployment configuration plus an archival README.
decision: Canonical repository selection is a product/governance gate.

title: Split hooks.ts behind one adapter registry
current: hooks.ts is 3,899 lines and combines discovery, installation, runtime repair, manifest parsing, and per-harness settings writers for eleven harness families.
evidence: apps/cli/src/lib/hooks/: existing cache and match modules
target: Keep hooks.ts as a compatibility facade; move discovery/install, runtime diagnostics, manifest handling, and one adapter per harness into src/lib/hooks, selected through one complete adapter registry.
boundary: Moves-only first; no hook event, settings shape, capability, or installed-file change.

title: One Rush agent-extension metadata contract
current: The harness reader and rush/cli writer duplicate the agent slug regex and describe the same agent_extensions row rules from opposite sides.
target: Put slug validation and row semantics in one harness-owned Go package already reachable from rush/cli; both reader and writer consume it.
boundary: Do not merge the two Go modules or move database ownership.

title: Split the linear-cli executable by command family
current: The extensionless linear entrypoint is 4,944 lines and its test file is 2,019 lines; the generic analyzers under-counted both because they omit extensionless source.
target: Keep one executable entrypoint but extract parser/transport, task read/write, project/milestone, comment, relation, and delegation command modules with matching test files.
boundary: Preserve every command name, JSON shape, config path, and delegate-only ownership model.

title: Collapse duplicate frozen extension archives
current: Both repositories are the exact same commit and tree and both point contributors at removed agents-cli/apps/factory.
target: Correct both redirects to agents-cli/apps/ext, retain one archived GitHub repository as the historical URL, and archive the duplicate.
decision: Which repository URL remains the archive is a governance gate.
